source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper defines random isolation, WRI and RDIM under full-neighborhood interference; Section 4.2 defines an MSE surrogate and candidate-weight selection based on it, rather than an exact tagged-risk oracle.
The paper studies greedy independent sets and matchings in regular/high-girth graphs and limiting expected weighted performance, not finite feedback-core exact tagged moments.
The article gives a local-convergence framework for asymptotic density of random greedy maximal independent sets and analyzes tree behavior.
The article computes static independent-set counts of all sizes on treewidth-at-most-p graphs in O(2^p p n^3) time.
The paper develops design-based minimax risk under arbitrary neighborhood interference and gives conflict-graph structural upper and lower bounds for unrestricted procedures.
The paper studies minimax design for two-arm experiments and shows the role of mixed randomization under structured outcome classes.
The paper uses SDP for minimax optimal-design problems with a discretized design space and semidefinite-representable criteria.
